rules.meaning: a slide is drawn smaller or larger than the canvas, so its page shows an empty band or loses an edge
rules.suggestion: make each <section> exactly the canvas size and let its content fill it

rules.meaning: a box carries a thick colored stripe along one side only, the side-tab or top-bar accent
rules.suggestion: remove the stripe; mark the box with a tinted fill, an even hairline border on every side, type weight or an icon

rules.meaning: corners are rounded far past a restrained radius
rules.suggestion: round boxes by at most 24px

rules.meaning: a small label, eyebrow, badge or pill sits directly above a heading
rules.suggestion: remove the label, or fold what it says into the heading or the line under it

rules.meaning: an icon or icon tile is stacked above a heading
rules.suggestion: drop the icon, or set it on the heading's line beside its first word

rules.meaning: three or more sibling cards repeat one structure at one size, a grid of identical cards
rules.suggestion: give the items the form their content has: a table, a list, a chart, a sequence, or cards of different weight

rules.meaning: a card is drawn inside another card
rules.suggestion: keep one level of boxes; separate the inner parts with space or a hairline

rules.meaning: text is painted with a gradient
rules.suggestion: set text in one solid color from the palette

rules.meaning: a box blurs what lies behind it, the glass effect
rules.suggestion: give the box a solid fill from the palette

rules.meaning: the design system declares a gradient
rules.suggestion: declare solid colors only; let photos, charts and type carry the slide

rules.meaning: repeating stripes or a grid of lines decorate a background
rules.suggestion: use a solid background; let photos, charts and type carry the slide

rules.meaning: a radial gradient glows behind content as a halo
rules.suggestion: use a solid background; let photos, charts and type carry the slide

rules.meaning: a colored glow surrounds a box or text
rules.suggestion: remove the shadow; separate the box by its fill or an even hairline

rules.meaning: a hairline border is paired with a wide soft shadow
rules.suggestion: keep the hairline and drop the shadow, or keep a tight shadow and drop the border

rules.meaning: letters are squeezed together with negative letter-spacing
rules.suggestion: set letter-spacing to -0.02em or wider

rules.meaning: display type is a serif set in italic
rules.suggestion: set serif display type upright

rules.meaning: a title is set so large that it reads as a poster headline
rules.suggestion: set the title at the design system's title size

rules.meaning: the title is hardly larger than the body text, so nothing leads the eye
rules.suggestion: set the title at least 1.5 times the body size

rules.meaning: the ground is a cream or beige tint
rules.suggestion: use a white or neutral ground, or a dark one; put the deck's color in its accents

rules.meaning: a purple and blue pairing or gradient, or cyan type on a dark ground
rules.suggestion: choose an accent from one hue family and a secondary of a different character; keep cyan off dark grounds

rules.meaning: the design system names a font the skill does not bundle, so the PDF and PPTX would substitute another
rules.suggestion: name a bundled font family

rules.meaning: a slide strings clauses together with em dashes
rules.suggestion: split the sentence, or use a colon or a comma
